note: These are research candidates only. No price is approved. No price is production-ready.

pricing_architecture_findings.summary: Bricolage cannot share a single pricing architecture. Evidence identifies multiple distinct price families.

recommended_architectures.rationale: A 20-minute task still consumes a full artisan slot (travel + setup + work + return). Market minimum ~150–200 MAD per intervention regardless of task duration. Essential floor.
For predictable, bounded tasks (shelf install, curtain rod, mirror, small furniture). Kitea 200 MAD/item is market anchor. Client understands price before arrival.
Multi-task visits: first item includes travel cost; additional items priced lower (no incremental travel). Fairer than multiplying unit price × quantity.
300–550 MAD for 3–4 hours on-site. Economically optimal for 5+ small tasks. Avoids per-task billing overhead. Best for heterogeneous task lists.
100–180 MAD/h. Suitable for open-ended work, unknown scope, or complex repairs. 2h minimum billing is market practice. Risk: client uncertainty.
For tasks with predictable base + conditional complexity escape (TV mounting: fixed for standard wall/bracket; escape for reinforced concrete or cable concealment).
Labour standardized; hardware (bracket, shelf, rod, hinge) client-supplied or disclosed separately.
For structurally variable tasks: complex custom furniture, riad access, heavy wall-mounted items, full cable concealment, structural drilling.

services.label: Déplacement minimum / forfait visite
services.label_fr: Déplacement minimum — forfait visite de base
services.scope: Minimum charge for any standalone handyman visit, covering travel time and call-out cost regardless of task duration
inclusions: Standard consumables for one fixing point
services.complexity_escape: If task requires >30 min or becomes multi-task: transition to hourly or per-item pricing
services.notes: Key architectural decision: whether FIXEO adopts a minimum visit and how individual task prices interact with it.

services.label: Heure main d'oeuvre
services.scope: Open-ended or heterogeneous handyman work billed by the hour. Minimum 2h billing.
inclusions: Small consumables (screws, plugs for standard walls)
services.complexity_escape: Specialist trade work escapes to Electricité / Plomberie / Serrurerie
services.notes: Well-evidenced. Market practice = 2h minimum. Preferred for open-ended lists. Client uncertainty risk.

services.label: Demi-journée bricolage
services.scope: Artisan on-site for ~3–4 hours. Suitable for batched mixed task lists (5+ small tasks). Most economical architecture for multi-task visits.
services.complexity_escape: Structural, safety-critical, or specialist-trade tasks escape to relevant métier
services.notes: Explicitly documented as 'most economical formula' for batched work by multiple sources. Prevents unfair multiply-of-unit-price for multi-task visits.

services.label: Montage meuble petit
services.label_fr: Montage meuble petit (chaise, table basse, table de nuit, petite étagère en kit)
services.scope: Assembly of small flat-pack furniture: chair, small table, bedside table, small cabinet. Estimated assembly time: 30–60 min.
services.complexity_escape: Missing parts, damaged item, instructions missing: HORS PÉRIMÈTRE — stop and notify client before proceeding
services.notes: Kitea 200 MAD/item is the primary anchor. Independent artisans should price similarly.

services.label: Montage meuble moyen
services.label_fr: Montage meuble moyen (bureau, bibliothèque, commode, armoire simple 1 porte)
services.scope: Assembly of medium flat-pack furniture. Estimated assembly time: 1–2 hours.
services.complexity_escape: Multiple packages, structural issues, missing instructions → quote
services.notes: Limited size-specific Moroccan evidence. Range interpolated from small and large tiers.

services.label: Montage armoire / grand meuble
services.label_fr: Montage armoire ou grand meuble (PAX, armoire 2–3 portes, lit double, dressing)
services.scope: Assembly of large flat-pack furniture. Estimated assembly time: 2–3+ hours. May require wall anchoring for safety.
services.complexity_escape: IKEA PAX with sliding doors complex interior → quote; furniture requiring 2 persons → quote
services.notes: Full IKEA bedroom (lit + 2 chevets + PAX) = 500–900 MAD total. Per-armoire-only estimate 300–600 MAD. Low confidence — more evidence needed.

services.label: Pose étagère murale
services.label_fr: Pose étagère murale (étagère client-fournie, mur standard)
services.scope: Install one wall shelf. Client supplies shelf and brackets (or integrated kit). Wall: standard masonry/brick. Max load per indication: up to 20kg.
services.complexity_escape: Reinforced concrete wall → surcharge or quote; tile wall → surcharge or quote; heavy shelf (>20kg) → conditional assessment
services.notes: 150–300 MAD range from Allo-Maison. Limited dedicated evidence. Good candidate if scope is tightly defined.

services.label: Pose tringle à rideaux
services.scope: Install one curtain rod (tringle droite). Client supplies rod and fixings. Standard wall.
services.notes: No reliable Moroccan price evidence found. Manofix EUR data is international outlier. Would logically price similarly to shelf pose (150–200 MAD). Requires additional market research before calibration.

services.label: Fixation miroir mural
services.label_fr: Fixation miroir mural (miroir client-fourni, mur standard)
services.scope: Install wall mirror. Client supplies mirror. Weight determines complexity.
services.complexity_escape: Mirror >15kg → quote; tile or marble wall → surcharge; decorative frame requiring specialist attachment → quote
services.notes: No specific Moroccan price found. Would logically price 100–200 MAD for standard small mirror. Safety: heavy mirrors require structural assessment.

services.label: Fixation cadre / tableau
services.scope: Hang one framed picture or decorative item. Client-supplied item. Light to medium weight.
services.complexity_escape: Heavy artwork → assess; multiple frames → batch pricing applies
services.notes: No specific Moroccan evidence. Single small frame hanging is typically too small to be standalone FIXEO service — better as add-on within multi-task visit.

services.label: Fixation TV murale standard
services.label_fr: Fixation TV murale — support fixe, mur standard, support client-fourni
services.scope: Mount TV on wall using fixed bracket. Client supplies bracket. Wall: standard masonry or hollow brick. TV up to 55". Cables not concealed.
exclusions: Structural engineering for very heavy screens
complexity_escape: Reinforced concrete wall → surcharge or quote
Cable concealment in wall → escapes to ELECTRICITÉ if socket relocation needed
services.notes: Best-evidenced task in this métier. 300 MAD (m3allempro, 89 reviews, Casablanca) is the strongest anchor. 200–400 DH range corroborated by Stepone.ma. Client supplies bracket is market standard.

services.label: Fixation TV murale complexe
services.label_fr: Fixation TV murale — full-motion, câbles dissimulés, béton armé
services.scope: Complex TV wall mounting: full-motion bracket, cable concealment in wall, reinforced concrete, heavy/large screen (65"+).
services.complexity_escape: This IS the complex escape — upstream from BRIC-030
services.notes: Only one source. Should remain QUOTE_REQUIRED. Cable concealment in wall may require licensed electrician.

services.label: Accessoire salle de bain pose
services.label_fr: Pose accessoire salle de bain (porte-serviettes, patère, porte-papier, barre d'appui)
services.scope: Install one bathroom accessory on tile or standard wall. Client supplies accessory.
services.complexity_escape: Tile cracking risk → inform client; porcelain/marble tile → surcharge
services.notes: No dedicated Moroccan pricing found. Tile drilling is skill-intensive. Would logically be 100–200 MAD for one accessory.

services.label: Porte réglage / charnière réglage
services.label_fr: Réglage porte qui frotte ou ferme mal — charnières et paumelles
services.scope: Adjust door that sticks, rubs, or doesn't close properly. Adjust hinges (charnières/paumelles). Does NOT include structural door issues.
services.complexity_escape: Structural frame damage → MAÇONNERIE; lock problem → SERRURERIE; custom door → MENUISERIE
services.notes: Range inferred from hourly rates and task duration (~30–60 min). No dedicated Moroccan source found.

services.label: Poignée porte remplacement simple
services.label_fr: Remplacement poignée ou serrure de meuble
services.scope: Replace door handle (poignée) on interior door or furniture. Does NOT include door lock cylinder.
services.notes: Quick task, 15–30 min. Low confidence — no dedicated source.

services.label: Petites finitions / silicone
services.scope: Apply silicone sealant for decorative/light sealing (not plumbing leaks). Max 2–3 linear meters.
services.complexity_escape: Water leak context → PLOMBERIE; tile re-grouting → CARRELAGE
services.notes: Typically appears as add-on task in multi-task visits. Standalone silicone job may be too cheap to justify separate FIXEO trip.

services.label: Visite multi-tâches
services.label_fr: Visite multi-tâches — liste de petits travaux
services.scope: Client provides list of multiple small tasks (shelves, TV, curtain rods, adjustments) to be done in one visit.
inclusions: All listed tasks up to demi-journée
services.complexity_escape: Any task requiring specialist → escape that task; rest continue
services.notes: Half-day model (BRIC-003) is the practical implementation. Alternatively: first item price includes travel; additional items at reduced incremental rate. Architecture decision for human calibration.

services_deferred_or_excluded.label: Luminaire installation
services_deferred_or_excluded.reason: Replacing a light fixture involves working with live electrical circuits or requires isolating the circuit at the tableau. This is ELECTRICITÉ scope per frozen doctrine. Exception: purely mechanical swap of a pendant on existing intact cable, no wiring work — borderline, needs doctrine clarification.

services_deferred_or_excluded.label: Prise / interrupteur remplacement
services_deferred_or_excluded.reason: Replacing electrical outlets or switches requires work on live circuits. Frozen ELECTRICITÉ doctrine covers this. Bricolage scope explicitly excludes this.

services_deferred_or_excluded.label: Déplacement TV cable électrique
services_deferred_or_excluded.reason: Electrical socket relocation for TV installation is ELECTRICITÉ. Explicitly excluded from TV mounting scope.

services_deferred_or_excluded.label: Robinetterie / fuite plomberie
services_deferred_or_excluded.reason: Any plumbing modification, pipe work, or leak repair escapes to PLOMBERIE. Market evidence notes handymen often do minor plumbing (joint de robinet, siphon) — but FIXEO doctrine should require PLOMBERIE for anything beyond truly superficial consumer-grade maintenance.
services_deferred_or_excluded.borderline_note: Joint de robinet (washer), flexible de douche, siphon — market classifies as handyman. FIXEO should decide based on risk tolerance.

services_deferred_or_excluded.label: Cylindre / serrure remplacement
services_deferred_or_excluded.reason: Lock cylinder and security lock replacement is frozen SERRURERIE scope.

services_deferred_or_excluded.label: Menuiserie sur mesure / travaux bois structurels
services_deferred_or_excluded.reason: Custom woodwork, built-in wardrobes, structural carpentry is MENUISERIE.

services_deferred_or_excluded.label: Mur porteur / percement structurel
services_deferred_or_excluded.reason: Any structural wall drilling or modification requires MAÇONNERIE or structural engineer assessment.

services_deferred_or_excluded.label: Carrelage pose / remplacement
services_deferred_or_excluded.reason: Tile laying, replacement, and re-grouting is CARRELAGE scope.

services_deferred_or_excluded.label: Perçage simple standalone
services_deferred_or_excluded.reason: Standalone drilling without a fixing goal is not a commercially viable separate FIXEO service. Drilling is included within shelf/TV/curtain rod services.

services_deferred_or_excluded.label: Serrure grippée / porte grippée
services_deferred_or_excluded.reason: Simple door adjustment (sticking due to humidity) = BRICOLAGE. Lock mechanism issue = SERRURERIE. Must triage on arrival.

services_deferred_or_excluded.label: Cuisine IKEA montage complet
services_deferred_or_excluded.reason: Full IKEA kitchen assembly (8–12 cabinets, worktop, appliance installation) takes 2–4 days. Price is highly variable. Should be DEVIS.
services_deferred_or_excluded.recommendation: QUOTE_REQUIRED — not standardizable as fixed FIXEO price

services_deferred_or_excluded.label: Hauteur / travaux en hauteur (>2.5m)
services_deferred_or_excluded.reason: Work above standard step ladder height (>2.5m) requires proper scaffolding equipment. This is a complexity escape condition, not a separate service category.
services_deferred_or_excluded.recommendation: Add as escape condition to relevant services
